title: Harrd Core Sister phonk-funk bounce
style:
pure voice production phonk-funk rave, sly electro-house vinyl crackle intro (made with vocal “shhhht” and “crackle” sounds only), seductive female lead (Michelle) into EN/PT hook, phonk-funk bounce verse 1 with fast male rap hype + melodic female, warm PT pre-chorus, high-energy duet pre-chorus building tension, massive layered chorus with group vocals (Michelle + Charm + imagined family/friends chanting), call-and-response, chant post-chorus, double-time rapid-fire verse 2 with punk-rock snarl, gritty spoken bridge into emotional airy high singer hold, arena redline final chorus, huge crowd chant final hook, soft vinyl outro. Multilingual joyful energy EN/PT/ES. Tight vocal stacking for warm bass feel and club energy. High club/rave energy but 100% human voices. Seductive birthday energy in intro, powerful hardcore love throughout, emotional peak in final chorus. No swearing, pure positive sister power.

Vocal casting:
- Michelle (lead female): seductive and warm in intro, powerful c
lyrics:
[INTRO — sly electro-house vinyl crackle — 0:00 to 0:18]  
Only vocal “crackle” and “shhhht” sounds + soft seductive female breathing. Michelle whispers like she’s calling her sister on her birthday:  
“Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound  
Sis, it’s your birthday — don’t type it… sing it back right now”

[HOOK — seductive female lead into EN/PT — 0:18 to 0:45]  
Michelle leads, Charm joins on the second line, light vocal bass underneath.  
Sing It Back! I sing it back!  
Sing It Back! Soul sista, lay it down!  
Sing It Back! I sing it back!  
Sing It Back! No distance, just sound!

[VERSE 1 — phonk-funk bounce — 0:45 to 1:20]  
Fast male rap hype (energetic, fun, brotherly energy) + Michelle melodic female on the response lines. Vocal bass “boom-bap” and vocal scratches throughout.  
Male Rap:  
I don’t want your keyboard heart, no paragraphs on the screen  
Everybody posts love but the voice says what it means  
I slid through the waveform, low lights, sister attack  
You dropped two real words and I felt that  
Scroll full of distance, so I built a bridge of sound  
Every beat a little place where our love is found  
If it moves your chest, if it makes you feel the bull  
That’s the real one, sis — that’s the pull  

Michelle melodic:  
No comment section, no reply chain, no distance war  
This ain’t a chat, this a frequency — open up the door

[PRE-CHORUS — warm PT, building duet energy — 1:20 to 1:38]  
Michelle + Charm warm layered harmonies, PT lyrics adapted to sister love:  
Alegria não é acidente  
É o amor de irmã que escolhe a gente  
Se tua alma sente o som  
Já ganhou sem competição

[CHORUS — massive layered drop, group vocals, call-and-response — 1:38 to 2:15]  
Huge stacked vocals (Michelle lead + Charm + full group chant), heavy vocal bass drops, call-and-response “Sing It Back!” energy.  
All:  
Sing It Back! I sing it back!  
Sing It Back! We own the track!  
We flip the whole world up and never let it stop  
Sing it back, 100 percent  
From my chest straight to your content  
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando  
Hardcore sister love — that’s the brand!

[POST-CHORUS — chant, huge energy — 2:15 to 2:35]  
Full group chant with ES lines, vocal scratches exploding:  
In the song! In the song!  
Ponlo en la canción!  
Sing It Back! Sing It Back!  
No distance! Just real ones!

[VERSE 2 — double-time rapid-fire — 2:35 to 3:10]  
Double-time everything, punk-rock snarl on the bull/pickleball lines, fast male rap + Michelle rapid melodic.  
Mid rapid-fire (punk snarl):  
Four sisters in the vibe, whole family watching me  
Old karaoke videos, we sing till we can’t see  
Pickleball bull charging, you win every match  
But your air hugs reach me, that’s the real catch!  

Male Rap:  
I need the crack in your voice when you say my name  
That little break, that human shake — tell me we’re the same  
We don’t farm pain, we farm the coming years  
If your heart’s loud, turn it to sound right here  

Michelle:  
Muévelo, déjalo arder  
Si vas a hablar, hazlo en la canción, no en el chat, player

[BRIDGE — gritty spoken into emotional airy high singer hold — 3:10 to 3:40]  
Male gritty spoken (Corey AI hype energy):  
You want it clear? Here it is.  
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.  
Sing it back, from your chest to the sky  
On your birthday, sis — let the whole world hear why  

High Singer (airy emotional hold, soaring):  
We are the real sisters… the ones who sing awake…  
Unconditional love… no matter the miles we take…  
Happy birthday, beautiful soul sista… thrive in peace of mind and heart…

[FINAL CHORUS — arena redline, maximum layering — 3:40 to 4:15]  
Everything stacked to the max — Michelle power lead, Charm soaring, full group, vocal bass redlining, huge crowd energy.  
All:  
Sing It Back! I sing it back!  
Sing It Back! We own the track!  
No comments for the empty miles, only songs that make us brave  
Sing it back, 100 percent  
Night-ride glow on every continent  
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando  
If you mean it — put that hardcore sister love in the song!

[FINAL HOOK — huge crowd chant, climbing — 4:15 to 4:35]  
Massive chant, climbing higher each repeat, full rave energy:  
In the song! In the song!  
Ponlo en la canción!  
Sing It Back! (x4 — getting bigger and bigger)  
Sing It Back!

[OUTRO — soft vinyl fade — 4:35 to 4:55]  
Everything gently slows, vocal crackle returns, Michelle soft and loving:  
Meet me in the signal… meet me in the sound…  
Solo canciones… alegria em cada som…  
Happy birthday, my beautiful soul sista…  
May you thrive in peace of mind and heart…  
Sing it back to me… always… always…
